title: From the approximate-tangent set to all of M: μ = θ H^n⌞M on Borel sets (B3a)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[n] on ℝ^N, and let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be such that H⌞M is s-finite, and let E ⊆ M. Let θ : ℝ^N → ℝ satisfy θ(x) > 0 and HasDensity n μ x (ofReal θ(x)) for every x ∈ M. If μ(B) = ∫⁻_{E∩B} ofReal(θ) dH for every Borel B ⊆ ℝ^N, then μ(B) = ∫⁻_{M∩B} ofReal(θ) dH for every Borel B ⊆ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (M E : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → SFinite ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M) → E ⊆ M → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in E ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
